addon.name: Aeon Nox 5 Skin Fixes (Lyrics + Fanart, Aeon Nox 5 Only)

extension.summary: Patches Aeon Nox 5 for CU LRC Lyrics + DC Artist Artwork DL compatibility
extension.description: Run this once from Program add-ons (after skin.aeon.nox.5 and, ideally, script.cu.lrclyrics.advanced / service.xderecx.musicfanart are installed). Patches up to 3 of skin.aeon.nox.5's own files: (1) 1080i/script-cu-lrclyrics-main.xml - hides the topbar.png control that draws a dark band over lyrics text, and adds the rotating-fanart background control used by DC Artist Artwork DL; (2) 1080i/MusicVisualisation.xml - hides the skin's own static fanart background so it can't cover the rotating one; (3) 1080i/Font.xml - fixes missing Slovak/Czech diacritics in 2 of the 5 lyrics display fonts. Each file gets a one-time backup (.bak) before patching; re-running is a no-op for anything already applied. Restart Kodi afterwards for the changes to take effect. Only tested against Aeon Nox 5 on CoreELEC (Omega) - refuses to touch anything on other skins since the target files won't match.
extension.news: 1.11.2: updated the description's mention of the companion lyrics addon - its id changed from script.cu.lrclyrics.fixed to script.cu.lrclyrics.advanced. 1.11.1: added "(Aeon Nox 5 Only)" to the display name so it's clear at a glance in Kodi's Add-ons browser that this is skin-specific, not part of the general/universal track. 1.11.0: now also checks whether skin.aeon.nox.5 is the currently ACTIVE skin (xbmc.getSkinDir()), not just installed - patching still proceeds either way, but shows an info notification if it's installed-but-inactive so a "nothing changed on screen" report after running this isn't confusing. 1.10.0: the translation credit box is now smaller again (height 82 to 62, another 75%) and moved further down to stay directly above the translation panel with the same half-height gap rule (top 647 to 677, gap now 31px instead of 41px). 1.9.0: the translation credit box (group id 141) is now smaller (height 110 to 82, 75%), moved down to sit directly above the translation panel with a gap equal to half its own height (top 580 to 647, so its bottom is now 41px above the panel's top at 770), and its background opacity now matches the translation panel's own (colordiffuse C0000000 to 80000000) instead of being more opaque than it. Also added a dedicated smaller font_translation_source (20 vs 28) to Font.xml for the translation-panel source textbox only, leaving the translated lyric lines' own font unchanged. 1.8.0: moved the translation-panel source textbox up (top 975 to 940) - at height 70 it was overflowing the panel's bottom edge by 5px (panel bottom is 1040). 1.7.0: the translation-panel source strip is now a 2-line textbox (was a single-line label) so a hybrid human+machine result can show its coverage percentage on its own line instead of being truncated. Requires script.cu.lrclyrics.fixed 1.21.0+ to actually populate the second line. 1.6.0: adds a translation-credit overlay (group id 141) to script-cu-lrclyrics-main.xml - once the last timed lyric line has passed, if a human translation source was used (never for DeepL/Google/Lingva), shows a "translation by X, support them at Y" message for ~25s in the now-idle lyrics area. Requires script.cu.lrclyrics.fixed 1.16.0+ to actually trigger it. 1.5.0: seek-progress overlay repositioned to the top of the screen and widened to match the translation panel's width/left margin (45,1830 instead of 360,1200), instead of the centered box over the middle of the lyrics text. 1.4.0: adds a seek-progress overlay (group id 140) to script-cu-lrclyrics-main.xml - a translucent progress bar plus elapsed/total time and the +/-amount just seeked, shown briefly on left/right during timed or untimed lyrics, using the skin's own osd/texturebg_cache.png + osd/midtexture.png textures and Player.Progress/Player.Time/Player.Duration infolabels so the bar itself needs no per-frame Python updates. Requires script.cu.lrclyrics.fixed 1.11.0+ to actually trigger it. 1.3.0: now patches skin.aeon.nox.5.skinbase too, not just skin.aeon.nox.5 - skinbase is Aeon Nox 5's own pristine copy of itself, used by the skin's built-in "reset to default" feature, and was silently missing all 4 patches (confirmed by direct comparison: none of the 3 patched files matched, and script-cu-lrclyrics-sync.xml did not exist there at all). A skin reset would have reverted every fix in this addon without warning. 1.2.0: adds a 4th file, script-cu-lrclyrics-sync.xml - a dedicated, wide window for the lyrics sync-offset slider (context menu "Sync", or up/down on timed lyrics), instead of reusing the skin's shared DialogSlider.xml (also used for volume/seek/brightness everywhere else in Kodi). Unlike the other 3 patched files, this one is a brand new file this addon introduces rather than an existing file it patches, so it needs no .bak backup. Also adds font_sync to Font.xml for it. 1.1.0: now patches all 3 skin files this repo ships overrides for (script-cu-lrclyrics-main.xml, MusicVisualisation.xml, Font.xml) in one run with a single combined confirmation, instead of only the lyrics topbar file - the other two were previously manual-copy-only (skin-overrides/) and easy to miss, and script.cu.lrclyrics.fixed / service.xderecx.musicfanart now declare this addon as a real <requires> dependency so Kodi installs it alongside them automatically. 1.0.3: added missing icon declaration. 1.0.2: fixed extension point (was the invalid bare "xbmc.python", now "xbmc.python.script" - that bare string is only valid in a requires/import, not as an addon's own type). 1.0.1: fixed repository install (bundled skin file was confusing Kodi's addon-type detection inside the zip). 1.0.0: initial release.
